summary: Security fix: fail closed when Linux local caller ancestry has an empty or incomplete environment or has not exec'd since fork.

compatibility.detail: Linux callers with empty or non-NUL-terminated environ, or PF_FORKNOEXEC set in proc stat, are unverifiable rather than persons. Existing unverifiable-caller guards refuse authority-bearing requests; ordinary unattributed reads remain available. A deliberately empty environment also fails closed. macOS is unchanged.

recovery.detail: Invoke authority-bearing local requests from an exec'd process with a readable, nonempty, complete environment.
